caption: Performance of different triggers. The words used as triggers on the horizontal axis are arranged in ascending order according to the ASR of the clean model.

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the ASR against different keywords in a clean-label setup with a poison rate of 5% (2.6% of total) for the SST-2 dataset. The x-axis is labeled with various keywords: bb, mb, cf, beautiful, excellent, gorgeous, wonderful, brilliant, stunning, beautifully, with no numerical scale and regularly spaced tick labels. The y-axis is labeled "ASR", with a linear scale ranging from 0.2 to 0.9, in increments of 0.1. There are three lines represented in the plot. The green line with circle markers, indicating "start", begins at an ASR of approximately 0.2 and peaks around 0.75 at "mb" and 0.77 at "excellent" and ends around 0.85, showing initial fluctuations and a sharp rise from "gorgeous" onward. The orange line with cross markers, labeled "random", starts at an ASR of about 0.53, decreases to around 0.2 at "cf", then sharply increases again to 0.6 at "beautiful", finishing near 0.9. The purple line with circle markers, labeled "end", starts around 0.5, rises steadily with fluctuation, ending around 0.8. The lines demonstrate varying patterns of ASR against the keywords. A legend is given bottom right.
